$comment: Settings › Notifications defaults (design 02): which business events reach a team member by push, SMS and email until they change a cell, and the quiet hours (America/Edmonton). The api's messaging NotificationMatrix and the worker's notifications consumer (S-27) both follow this file; NotificationMatrixDefaultsSpecTest keeps the api's copy equal.

customer.$comment: Account › Notifications defaults (design 06, S-59): which updates reach a customer by push, SMS and email until they change a cell, and their quiet hours (in the time zone of the province they shop in, else the platform zone). The api's CustomerNotificationPrefs and the worker's customer notifications (S-102) both follow this; NotificationMatrixDefaultsSpecTest keeps the api's copy equal. Security alerts are always on.
